en.app_sub: Fully autonomous · preventives · quiet Setup · RunOnce resume
en.note: Max autonomy: auto-elevate, install ALL preventives, runtime remediations, quiet Setup, auto-reboot/RunOnce. Keeps files & apps. Pure Python — NO .NET 4.x / NO PowerShell
en.confirm_upgrade:
Run stepped migration (intermediate versions if needed)?
Example: Win10 1511 -> 22H2 -> Win11 latest.
(Only shown if MAGIC_CONFIRM=1)
en.need_admin:
Administrator rights are required.
Relaunch as admin?

Windows Setup launched quietly.
The PC will reboot; the chain continues automatically (RunOnce).
en.done_reboot:
Reboot scheduled for prep.
After reboot, One-Click resumes automatically (RunOnce).

Finished with code {code}.
See Desktop MigrationReport.txt + SupportGuide.txt
